<callrestsequence><calls><Elem><url>https://sumitomo.thereforeonline.com/theservice/v0001/restun/SaveEFormDraft</url><verb>POST</verb><urlpar></urlpar><hdrpar><Elem><K>Tenantname</K><V>"sumitomo"</V><D></D></Elem><Elem><K>Authorization</K><V>"Bearer " + jwt</V><D></D></Elem></hdrpar><initscript>https://sumitomo.thereforeonline.com/theservice/v0001/restun/help/operations/SaveEFormDraft

/**
 * 
 * JWT Generator for JScript - Therefore scripting engine
 * Includes HMAC-SHA256 and Base64 implementations
 * No external dependencies required
 * Use this script to create a JWT in a Therefore workflow,
 * this enables you to execute a REST call as a particular user, such as create document etc
 * rather than having it performed by a predefined user. Define one Custom JWT configuration in 
 * Therefore, and re-use it for any user you want to impersonate when doing a REST Call
 */

// ============================================
// SHA256 Implementation
// ============================================

function sha256(message) {
    // SHA256 constants - first 32 bits of fractional parts of cube roots of first 64 primes
    var K = [
        0x428a2f98, 0x71374491, 0xb5c0fbcf, 0xe9b5dba5, 0x3956c25b, 0x59f111f1, 0x923f82a4, 0xab1c5ed5,
        0xd807aa98, 0x12835b01, 0x243185be, 0x550c7dc3, 0x72be5d74, 0x80deb1fe, 0x9bdc06a7, 0xc19bf174,
        0xe49b69c1, 0xefbe4786, 0x0fc19dc6, 0x240ca1cc, 0x2de92c6f, 0x4a7484aa, 0x5cb0a9dc, 0x76f988da,
        0x983e5152, 0xa831c66d, 0xb00327c8, 0xbf597fc7, 0xc6e00bf3, 0xd5a79147, 0x06ca6351, 0x14292967,
        0x27b70a85, 0x2e1b2138, 0x4d2c6dfc, 0x53380d13, 0x650a7354, 0x766a0abb, 0x81c2c92e, 0x92722c85,
        0xa2bfe8a1, 0xa81a664b, 0xc24b8b70, 0xc76c51a3, 0xd192e819, 0xd6990624, 0xf40e3585, 0x106aa070,
        0x19a4c116, 0x1e376c08, 0x2748774c, 0x34b0bcb5, 0x391c0cb3, 0x4ed8aa4a, 0x5b9cca4f, 0x682e6ff3,
        0x748f82ee, 0x78a5636f, 0x84c87814, 0x8cc70208, 0x90befffa, 0xa4506ceb, 0xbef9a3f7, 0xc67178f2
    ];

    // Initial hash values - first 32 bits of fractional parts of square roots of first 8 primes
    var H = [0x6a09e667, 0xbb67ae85, 0x3c6ef372, 0xa54ff53a, 0x510e527f, 0x9b05688c, 0x1f83d9ab, 0x5be0cd19];

    // Convert message string to byte array (ASCII only for JScript compatibility)
    var msgBytes = [];
    for (var i = 0; i < message.length; i++) {
        msgBytes.push(message.charCodeAt(i) & 0xFF);
    }

    // Padding
    var bitLen = msgBytes.length * 8;
    msgBytes.push(0x80);
    while ((msgBytes.length % 64) !== 56) {
        msgBytes.push(0);
    }
    
    // Append length as 64-bit big-endian
    msgBytes.push(0);
    msgBytes.push(0);
    msgBytes.push(0);
    msgBytes.push(0);
    msgBytes.push((bitLen >>> 24) & 0xFF);
    msgBytes.push((bitLen >>> 16) & 0xFF);
    msgBytes.push((bitLen >>> 8) & 0xFF);
    msgBytes.push(bitLen & 0xFF);

    // Process each 64-byte chunk
    for (var chunkStart = 0; chunkStart < msgBytes.length; chunkStart += 64) {
        var W = new Array(64);
        
        // Break chunk into sixteen 32-bit words
        for (var i = 0; i < 16; i++) {
            W[i] = ((msgBytes[chunkStart + i * 4] << 24) |
                    (msgBytes[chunkStart + i * 4 + 1] << 16) |
                    (msgBytes[chunkStart + i * 4 + 2] << 8) |
                    (msgBytes[chunkStart + i * 4 + 3])) >>> 0;
        }

        // Extend the sixteen 32-bit words into sixty-four 32-bit words
        for (var i = 16; i < 64; i++) {
            var s0 = ((W[i - 15] >>> 7) | (W[i - 15] << 25)) ^
                     ((W[i - 15] >>> 18) | (W[i - 15] << 14)) ^
                     (W[i - 15] >>> 3);
            var s1 = ((W[i - 2] >>> 17) | (W[i - 2] << 15)) ^
                     ((W[i - 2] >>> 19) | (W[i - 2] << 13)) ^
                     (W[i - 2] >>> 10);
            W[i] = (W[i - 16] + s0 + W[i - 7] + s1) >>> 0;
        }

        // Initialize working variables
        var a = H[0], b = H[1], c = H[2], d = H[3];
        var e = H[4], f = H[5], g = H[6], h = H[7];

        // Compression loop
        for (var i = 0; i < 64; i++) {
            var S1 = ((e >>> 6) | (e << 26)) ^
                     ((e >>> 11) | (e << 21)) ^
                     ((e >>> 25) | (e << 7));
            var ch = (e & f) ^ ((~e) & g);
            var temp1 = (h + S1 + ch + K[i] + W[i]) >>> 0;
            var S0 = ((a >>> 2) | (a << 30)) ^
                     ((a >>> 13) | (a << 19)) ^
                     ((a >>> 22) | (a << 10));
            var maj = (a & b) ^ (a & c) ^ (b & c);
            var temp2 = (S0 + maj) >>> 0;

            h = g;
            g = f;
            f = e;
            e = (d + temp1) >>> 0;
            d = c;
            c = b;
            b = a;
            a = (temp1 + temp2) >>> 0;
        }

        // Add to hash
        H[0] = (H[0] + a) >>> 0;
        H[1] = (H[1] + b) >>> 0;
        H[2] = (H[2] + c) >>> 0;
        H[3] = (H[3] + d) >>> 0;
        H[4] = (H[4] + e) >>> 0;
        H[5] = (H[5] + f) >>> 0;
        H[6] = (H[6] + g) >>> 0;
        H[7] = (H[7] + h) >>> 0;
    }

    // Convert hash to hex string
    var hex = "0123456789abcdef";
    var result = "";
    for (var i = 0; i < 8; i++) {
        for (var j = 7; j >= 0; j--) {
            result += hex.charAt((H[i] >>> (j * 4)) & 0xF);
        }
    }
    return result;
}

// ============================================
// HMAC-SHA256 Implementation
// ============================================

function hmacSha256(key, message) {
    // Convert key to byte array
    var keyBytes = [];
    for (var i = 0; i < key.length; i++) {
        keyBytes.push(key.charCodeAt(i) & 0xFF);
    }

    // If key is longer than 64 bytes, hash it
    if (keyBytes.length > 64) {
        var keyHash = sha256(key);
        keyBytes = [];
        for (var i = 0; i < keyHash.length; i += 2) {
            keyBytes.push(parseInt(keyHash.substr(i, 2), 16));
        }
    }

    // Pad key to 64 bytes
    var ipad = [];
    var opad = [];
    
    for (var i = 0; i < 64; i++) {
        var b = i < keyBytes.length ? keyBytes[i] : 0;
        ipad.push(b ^ 0x36);
        opad.push(b ^ 0x5C);
    }

    // Build inner message: ipad || message
    var innerMsg = "";
    for (var i = 0; i < 64; i++) {
        innerMsg += String.fromCharCode(ipad[i]);
    }
    innerMsg += message;

    // Inner hash
    var innerHash = sha256(innerMsg);

    // Build outer message: opad || innerHash
    var outerMsg = "";
    for (var i = 0; i < 64; i++) {
        outerMsg += String.fromCharCode(opad[i]);
    }
    // Convert innerHash hex to string
    for (var i = 0; i < innerHash.length; i += 2) {
        outerMsg += String.fromCharCode(parseInt(innerHash.substr(i, 2), 16));
    }

    // Return outer hash as byte array
    var resultHex = sha256(outerMsg);
    var resultBytes = [];
    for (var i = 0; i < resultHex.length; i += 2) {
        resultBytes.push(parseInt(resultHex.substr(i, 2), 16));
    }
    return resultBytes;
}

// ============================================
// Base64URL Encoding (RFC 4648)
// ============================================

var BASE64URL_CHARS = "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789-_";

function base64UrlEncode(bytes) {
    var result = "";
    var i = 0;
    
    while (i < bytes.length) {
        var b1 = bytes[i++];
        var b2 = i < bytes.length ? bytes[i++] : -1;
        var b3 = i < bytes.length ? bytes[i++] : -1;

        // 6-bit groups
        var bitmap = (b1 << 16) | ((b2 & 0xFF) << 8) | (b3 & 0xFF);
        
        result += BASE64URL_CHARS.charAt((bitmap >> 18) & 63);
        result += BASE64URL_CHARS.charAt((bitmap >> 12) & 63);
        result += b2 !== -1 ? BASE64URL_CHARS.charAt((bitmap >> 6) & 63) : "";
        result += b3 !== -1 ? BASE64URL_CHARS.charAt(bitmap & 63) : "";
    }

    return result;
}

function base64EncodeString(str) {
    var chars = "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789+/=";
    var out = "";
    var i = 0;
    while (i < str.length) {
        var c1 = str.charCodeAt(i++) & 0xff;
        var c2 = str.charCodeAt(i++) & 0xff;
        var c3 = str.charCodeAt(i++) & 0xff;
        
        out += chars.charAt(c1 >> 2);
        out += chars.charAt(((c1 & 0x3) << 4) | (c2 >> 4));
        out += isNaN(c2) ? "=" : chars.charAt(((c2 & 0xf) << 2) | (c3 >> 6));
        out += isNaN(c3) ? "=" : chars.charAt(c3 & 0x3f);
    }
    return out;
}

function stringToBytes(str) {
    var bytes = [];
    for (var i = 0; i < str.length; i++) {
        var c = str.charCodeAt(i);
        // UTF-8 encoding
        if (c < 128) {
            bytes.push(c);
        } else if (c < 2048) {
            bytes.push(0xC0 | (c >> 6));
            bytes.push(0x80 | (c & 0x3F));
        } else {
            bytes.push(0xE0 | (c >> 12));
            bytes.push(0x80 | ((c >> 6) & 0x3F));
            bytes.push(0x80 | (c & 0x3F));
        }
    }
    return bytes;
}

// ============================================
// JWT Generator
// ============================================

function generateJWT(header, payload, secret) {
    // Convert objects to JSON strings
    var headerJSON = JSON.stringify(header);
    var payloadJSON = JSON.stringify(payload);

    // Encode header and payload to Base64URL
    var headerBase64 = base64UrlEncode(stringToBytes(headerJSON));
    var payloadBase64 = base64UrlEncode(stringToBytes(payloadJSON));

    // Create signing input
    var signingInput = headerBase64 + "." + payloadBase64;

    // Sign with HMAC-SHA256
    var signatureBytes = hmacSha256(secret, signingInput);
    var signatureBase64 = base64UrlEncode(signatureBytes);

    // Return complete JWT
    return signingInput + "." + signatureBase64;
}

// ============================================
// Main Execution
// ============================================

function createToken(issuer, tenantCustomerId, expiration_seconds, scope, username, secret) {
    // JWT Header
    var header = {
        "alg": "HS256",
        "typ": "JWT"
    };
    
    var now = Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000);
    // JWT Payload
    var payload = {
        "iss": issuer,
        "aud": tenantCustomerId,
        "nbf": now,
        "exp": now + expiration_seconds,
        "urn:oauth:scope": scope,
        "http://schemas.microsoft.com/ws/2008/06/identity/claims/windowsaccountname": username
    };

    // Generate JWT
    return generateJWT(header, payload, secret);
}

var submissionData = base64EncodeString( JSON.stringify(submission));

/**
 * 
 * JWT Generator for JScript - Therefore scripting engine
 * Includes HMAC-SHA256 and Base64 implementations
 * No external dependencies required
 * Use this script to create a JWT in a Therefore workflow,
 * this enables you to execute a REST call as a particular user, such as create document etc
 * rather than having it performed by a predefined user. Define one Custom JWT configuration in 
 * Therefore, and re-use it for any user you want to impersonate when doing a REST Call
 */

// ============================================
// SHA256 Implementation
// ============================================

function sha256(message) {
    // SHA256 constants - first 32 bits of fractional parts of cube roots of first 64 primes
    var K = [
        0x428a2f98, 0x71374491, 0xb5c0fbcf, 0xe9b5dba5, 0x3956c25b, 0x59f111f1, 0x923f82a4, 0xab1c5ed5,
        0xd807aa98, 0x12835b01, 0x243185be, 0x550c7dc3, 0x72be5d74, 0x80deb1fe, 0x9bdc06a7, 0xc19bf174,
        0xe49b69c1, 0xefbe4786, 0x0fc19dc6, 0x240ca1cc, 0x2de92c6f, 0x4a7484aa, 0x5cb0a9dc, 0x76f988da,
        0x983e5152, 0xa831c66d, 0xb00327c8, 0xbf597fc7, 0xc6e00bf3, 0xd5a79147, 0x06ca6351, 0x14292967,
        0x27b70a85, 0x2e1b2138, 0x4d2c6dfc, 0x53380d13, 0x650a7354, 0x766a0abb, 0x81c2c92e, 0x92722c85,
        0xa2bfe8a1, 0xa81a664b, 0xc24b8b70, 0xc76c51a3, 0xd192e819, 0xd6990624, 0xf40e3585, 0x106aa070,
        0x19a4c116, 0x1e376c08, 0x2748774c, 0x34b0bcb5, 0x391c0cb3, 0x4ed8aa4a, 0x5b9cca4f, 0x682e6ff3,
        0x748f82ee, 0x78a5636f, 0x84c87814, 0x8cc70208, 0x90befffa, 0xa4506ceb, 0xbef9a3f7, 0xc67178f2
    ];

    // Initial hash values - first 32 bits of fractional parts of square roots of first 8 primes
    var H = [0x6a09e667, 0xbb67ae85, 0x3c6ef372, 0xa54ff53a, 0x510e527f, 0x9b05688c, 0x1f83d9ab, 0x5be0cd19];

    // Convert message string to byte array (ASCII only for JScript compatibility)
    var msgBytes = [];
    for (var i = 0; i < message.length; i++) {
        msgBytes.push(message.charCodeAt(i) & 0xFF);
    }

    // Padding
    var bitLen = msgBytes.length * 8;
    msgBytes.push(0x80);
    while ((msgBytes.length % 64) !== 56) {
        msgBytes.push(0);
    }
    
    // Append length as 64-bit big-endian
    msgBytes.push(0);
    msgBytes.push(0);
    msgBytes.push(0);
    msgBytes.push(0);
    msgBytes.push((bitLen >>> 24) & 0xFF);
    msgBytes.push((bitLen >>> 16) & 0xFF);
    msgBytes.push((bitLen >>> 8) & 0xFF);
    msgBytes.push(bitLen & 0xFF);

    // Process each 64-byte chunk
    for (var chunkStart = 0; chunkStart < msgBytes.length; chunkStart += 64) {
        var W = new Array(64);
        
        // Break chunk into sixteen 32-bit words
        for (var i = 0; i < 16; i++) {
            W[i] = ((msgBytes[chunkStart + i * 4] << 24) |
                    (msgBytes[chunkStart + i * 4 + 1] << 16) |
                    (msgBytes[chunkStart + i * 4 + 2] << 8) |
                    (msgBytes[chunkStart + i * 4 + 3])) >>> 0;
        }

        // Extend the sixteen 32-bit words into sixty-four 32-bit words
        for (var i = 16; i < 64; i++) {
            var s0 = ((W[i - 15] >>> 7) | (W[i - 15] << 25)) ^
                     ((W[i - 15] >>> 18) | (W[i - 15] << 14)) ^
                     (W[i - 15] >>> 3);
            var s1 = ((W[i - 2] >>> 17) | (W[i - 2] << 15)) ^
                     ((W[i - 2] >>> 19) | (W[i - 2] << 13)) ^
                     (W[i - 2] >>> 10);
            W[i] = (W[i - 16] + s0 + W[i - 7] + s1) >>> 0;
        }

        // Initialize working variables
        var a = H[0], b = H[1], c = H[2], d = H[3];
        var e = H[4], f = H[5], g = H[6], h = H[7];

        // Compression loop
        for (var i = 0; i < 64; i++) {
            var S1 = ((e >>> 6) | (e << 26)) ^
                     ((e >>> 11) | (e << 21)) ^
                     ((e >>> 25) | (e << 7));
            var ch = (e & f) ^ ((~e) & g);
            var temp1 = (h + S1 + ch + K[i] + W[i]) >>> 0;
            var S0 = ((a >>> 2) | (a << 30)) ^
                     ((a >>> 13) | (a << 19)) ^
                     ((a >>> 22) | (a << 10));
            var maj = (a & b) ^ (a & c) ^ (b & c);
            var temp2 = (S0 + maj) >>> 0;

            h = g;
            g = f;
            f = e;
            e = (d + temp1) >>> 0;
            d = c;
            c = b;
            b = a;
            a = (temp1 + temp2) >>> 0;
        }

        // Add to hash
        H[0] = (H[0] + a) >>> 0;
        H[1] = (H[1] + b) >>> 0;
        H[2] = (H[2] + c) >>> 0;
        H[3] = (H[3] + d) >>> 0;
        H[4] = (H[4] + e) >>> 0;
        H[5] = (H[5] + f) >>> 0;
        H[6] = (H[6] + g) >>> 0;
        H[7] = (H[7] + h) >>> 0;
    }

    // Convert hash to hex string
    var hex = "0123456789abcdef";
    var result = "";
    for (var i = 0; i < 8; i++) {
        for (var j = 7; j >= 0; j--) {
            result += hex.charAt((H[i] >>> (j * 4)) & 0xF);
        }
    }
    return result;
}

// ============================================
// HMAC-SHA256 Implementation
// ============================================

function hmacSha256(key, message) {
    // Convert key to byte array
    var keyBytes = [];
    for (var i = 0; i < key.length; i++) {
        keyBytes.push(key.charCodeAt(i) & 0xFF);
    }

    // If key is longer than 64 bytes, hash it
    if (keyBytes.length > 64) {
        var keyHash = sha256(key);
        keyBytes = [];
        for (var i = 0; i < keyHash.length; i += 2) {
            keyBytes.push(parseInt(keyHash.substr(i, 2), 16));
        }
    }

    // Pad key to 64 bytes
    var ipad = [];
    var opad = [];
    
    for (var i = 0; i < 64; i++) {
        var b = i < keyBytes.length ? keyBytes[i] : 0;
        ipad.push(b ^ 0x36);
        opad.push(b ^ 0x5C);
    }

    // Build inner message: ipad || message
    var innerMsg = "";
    for (var i = 0; i < 64; i++) {
        innerMsg += String.fromCharCode(ipad[i]);
    }
    innerMsg += message;

    // Inner hash
    var innerHash = sha256(innerMsg);

    // Build outer message: opad || innerHash
    var outerMsg = "";
    for (var i = 0; i < 64; i++) {
        outerMsg += String.fromCharCode(opad[i]);
    }
    // Convert innerHash hex to string
    for (var i = 0; i < innerHash.length; i += 2) {
        outerMsg += String.fromCharCode(parseInt(innerHash.substr(i, 2), 16));
    }

    // Return outer hash as byte array
    var resultHex = sha256(outerMsg);
    var resultBytes = [];
    for (var i = 0; i < resultHex.length; i += 2) {
        resultBytes.push(parseInt(resultHex.substr(i, 2), 16));
    }
    return resultBytes;
}

// ============================================
// Base64URL Encoding (RFC 4648)
// ============================================

var BASE64URL_CHARS = "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789-_";

function base64UrlEncode(bytes) {
    var result = "";
    var i = 0;
    
    while (i < bytes.length) {
        var b1 = bytes[i++];
        var b2 = i < bytes.length ? bytes[i++] : -1;
        var b3 = i < bytes.length ? bytes[i++] : -1;

        // 6-bit groups
        var bitmap = (b1 << 16) | ((b2 & 0xFF) << 8) | (b3 & 0xFF);
        
        result += BASE64URL_CHARS.charAt((bitmap >> 18) & 63);
        result += BASE64URL_CHARS.charAt((bitmap >> 12) & 63);
        result += b2 !== -1 ? BASE64URL_CHARS.charAt((bitmap >> 6) & 63) : "";
        result += b3 !== -1 ? BASE64URL_CHARS.charAt(bitmap & 63) : "";
    }

    return result;
}

function base64EncodeString(str) {
    var chars = "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789+/=";
    var out = "";
    var i = 0;
    while (i < str.length) {
        var c1 = str.charCodeAt(i++) & 0xff;
        var c2 = str.charCodeAt(i++) & 0xff;
        var c3 = str.charCodeAt(i++) & 0xff;
        
        out += chars.charAt(c1 >> 2);
        out += chars.charAt(((c1 & 0x3) << 4) | (c2 >> 4));
        out += isNaN(c2) ? "=" : chars.charAt(((c2 & 0xf) << 2) | (c3 >> 6));
        out += isNaN(c3) ? "=" : chars.charAt(c3 & 0x3f);
    }
    return out;
}

function stringToBytes(str) {
    var bytes = [];
    for (var i = 0; i < str.length; i++) {
        var c = str.charCodeAt(i);
        // UTF-8 encoding
        if (c < 128) {
            bytes.push(c);
        } else if (c < 2048) {
            bytes.push(0xC0 | (c >> 6));
            bytes.push(0x80 | (c & 0x3F));
        } else {
            bytes.push(0xE0 | (c >> 12));
            bytes.push(0x80 | ((c >> 6) & 0x3F));
            bytes.push(0x80 | (c & 0x3F));
        }
    }
    return bytes;
}

// ============================================
// JWT Generator
// ============================================

function generateJWT(header, payload, secret) {
    // Convert objects to JSON strings
    var headerJSON = JSON.stringify(header);
    var payloadJSON = JSON.stringify(payload);

    // Encode header and payload to Base64URL
    var headerBase64 = base64UrlEncode(stringToBytes(headerJSON));
    var payloadBase64 = base64UrlEncode(stringToBytes(payloadJSON));

    // Create signing input
    var signingInput = headerBase64 + "." + payloadBase64;

    // Sign with HMAC-SHA256
    var signatureBytes = hmacSha256(secret, signingInput);
    var signatureBase64 = base64UrlEncode(signatureBytes);

    // Return complete JWT
    return signingInput + "." + signatureBase64;
}

// ============================================
// Main Execution
// ============================================

function createToken(issuer, tenantCustomerId, expiration_seconds, scope, username, secret) {
    // JWT Header
    var header = {
        "alg": "HS256",
        "typ": "JWT"
    };
    
    var now = Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000);
    // JWT Payload
    var payload = {
        "iss": issuer,
        "aud": tenantCustomerId,
        "nbf": now,
        "exp": now + expiration_seconds,
        "urn:oauth:scope": scope,
        "http://schemas.microsoft.com/ws/2008/06/identity/claims/windowsaccountname": username
    };

    // Generate JWT
    return generateJWT(header, payload, secret);
}

        0x27b70a85, 0x2e1b2138, 0x4d2c6dfc, 0x53380d13, 0x650a7354, 0x766a0abb, 0x81c2c92e, 0x92722c85,
        0xa2bfe8a1, 0xa81a664b, 0xc24b8b70, 0xc76c51a3, 0xd192e819, 0xd6990624, 0xf40e3585, 0x106aa070,

        0x748f82ee, 0x78a5636f, 0x84c87814, 0x8cc70208, 0x90befffa, 0xa4506ceb, 0xbef9a3f7, 0xc67178f2
    ];

        0x748f82ee, 0x78a5636f, 0x84c87814, 0x8cc70208, 0x90befffa, 0xa4506ceb, 0xbef9a3f7, 0xc67178f2
    ];

function hmacSha256(key, message) {

        innerMsg += String.fromCharCode(ipad[i]);
    }
    innerMsg += message;

    // Inner hash
    var innerHash = sha256(innerMsg);

    // Build outer message: opad || innerHash
    var outerMsg = "";
    for (var i = 0; i < 64; i++) {
        outerMsg += String.fromCharCode(opad[i]);
    }
    // Convert innerHash hex to string
    for (var i = 0; i < innerHash.length; i += 2) {
        outerMsg += String.fromCharCode(parseInt(innerHash.substr(i, 2), 16));
    }

    // Return outer hash as byte array
    var resultHex = sha256(outerMsg);
    var resultBytes = [];
    for (var i = 0; i < resultHex.length; i += 2) {
        resultBytes.push(parseInt(resultHex.substr(i, 2), 16));
    }
    return resultBytes;
}

// ============================================
// Base64URL Encoding (RFC 4648)
// ============================================

var BASE64URL_CHARS = "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789-_";

function base64UrlEncode(bytes) {
    var result = "";
    var i = 0;
    
    while (i < bytes.length) {
        var b1 = bytes[i++];
        var b2 = i < bytes.length ? bytes[i++] : -1;
        var b3 = i < bytes.length ? bytes[i++] : -1;

        // 6-bit groups
        var bitmap = (b1 << 16) | ((b2 & 0xFF) << 8) | (b3 & 0xFF);
        
        result += BASE64URL_CHARS.charAt((bitmap >> 18) & 63);
        result += BASE64URL_CHARS.charAt((bitmap >> 12) & 63);
        result += b2 !== -1 ? BASE64URL_CHARS.charAt((bitmap >> 6) & 63) : "";
        result += b3 !== -1 ? BASE64URL_CHARS.charAt(bitmap & 63) : "";
    }

    return result;
}

function base64EncodeString(str) {
    var chars = "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789+/=";
    var out = "";
    var i = 0;
    while (i < str.length) {
        var c1 = str.charCodeAt(i++) & 0xff;
        var c2 = str.charCodeAt(i++) & 0xff;
        var c3 = str.charCodeAt(i++) & 0xff;
        
        out += chars.charAt(c1 >> 2);
        out += chars.charAt(((c1 & 0x3) << 4) | (c2 >> 4));
        out += isNaN(c2) ? "=" : chars.charAt(((c2 & 0xf) << 2) | (c3 >> 6));
        out += isNaN(c3) ? "=" : chars.charAt(c3 & 0x3f);
    }
    return out;
}

function stringToBytes(str) {
    var bytes = [];
    for (var i = 0; i < str.length; i++) {
        var c = str.charCodeAt(i);
        // UTF-8 encoding
        if (c < 128) {
            bytes.push(c);
        } else if (c < 2048) {
            bytes.push(0xC0 | (c >> 6));
            bytes.push(0x80 | (c & 0x3F));
        } else {
            bytes.push(0xE0 | (c >> 12));
            bytes.push(0x80 | ((c >> 6) & 0x3F));
            bytes.push(0x80 | (c & 0x3F));
        }
    }
    return bytes;
}

// ============================================
// JWT Generator
// ============================================

function generateJWT(header, payload, secret) {
    // Convert objects to JSON strings
    var headerJSON = JSON.stringify(header);
    var payloadJSON = JSON.stringify(payload);

    // Encode header and payload to Base64URL
    var headerBase64 = base64UrlEncode(stringToBytes(headerJSON));
    var payloadBase64 = base64UrlEncode(stringToBytes(payloadJSON));

    // Create signing input
    var signingInput = headerBase64 + "." + payloadBase64;

    // Sign with HMAC-SHA256
    var signatureBytes = hmacSha256(secret, signingInput);
    var signatureBase64 = base64UrlEncode(signatureBytes);

    // Return complete JWT
    return signingInput + "." + signatureBase64;
}

// ============================================
// Main Execution
// ============================================

function createToken(issuer, tenantCustomerId, expiration_seconds, scope, username, secret) {
    // JWT Header
    var header = {

        "typ": "JWT"

    // JWT Payload
    var payload = {

        "nbf": now,
        "exp": now + expiration_seconds,
        "urn:oauth:scope": scope,
        "http://schemas.microsoft.com/ws/2008/06/identity/claims/windowsaccountname": username
    };

    // Generate JWT
    return generateJWT(header, payload, secret);
}

/**

// ============================================

function sha256(message) {

        0xa2bfe8a1, 0xa81a664b, 0xc24b8b70, 0xc76c51a3, 0xd192e819, 0xd6990624, 0xf40e3585, 0x106aa070,
        0x19a4c116, 0x1e376c08, 0x2748774c, 0x34b0bcb5, 0x391c0cb3, 0x4ed8aa4a, 0x5b9cca4f, 0x682e6ff3,
        0x748f82ee, 0x78a5636f, 0x84c87814, 0x8cc70208, 0x90befffa, 0xa4506ceb, 0xbef9a3f7, 0xc67178f2
    ];

    // Initial hash values - first 32 bits of fractional parts of square roots of first 8 primes
    var H = [0x6a09e667, 0xbb67ae85, 0x3c6ef372, 0xa54ff53a, 0x510e527f, 0x9b05688c, 0x1f83d9ab, 0x5be0cd19];

    var msgBytes = [];
    for (var i = 0; i < message.length; i++) {
        msgBytes.push(message.charCodeAt(i) & 0xFF);
    }

    // Padding
    var bitLen = msgBytes.length * 8;
    msgBytes.push(0x80);
    while ((msgBytes.length % 64) !== 56) {
        msgBytes.push(0);
    }
    
    // Append length as 64-bit big-endian
    msgBytes.push(0);
    msgBytes.push(0);
    msgBytes.push(0);
    msgBytes.push(0);
    msgBytes.push((bitLen >>> 24) & 0xFF);
    msgBytes.push((bitLen >>> 16) & 0xFF);
    msgBytes.push((bitLen >>> 8) & 0xFF);
    msgBytes.push(bitLen & 0xFF);

    // Process each 64-byte chunk
    for (var chunkStart = 0; chunkStart < msgBytes.length; chunkStart += 64) {
        var W = new Array(64);

        var a = H[0], b = H[1], c = H[2], d = H[3];
        var e = H[4], f = H[5], g = H[6], h = H[7];

        for (var i = 0; i < 64; i++) {

            g = f;
            f = e;

            c = b;
            b = a;

        H[4] = (H[4] + e) >>> 0;
        H[5] = (H[5] + f) >>> 0;
        H[6] = (H[6] + g) >>> 0;
        H[7] = (H[7] + h) >>> 0;
    }

    // Convert hash to hex string
    var hex = "0123456789abcdef";
    var result = "";
    for (var i = 0; i < 8; i++) {
        for (var j = 7; j >= 0; j--) {

        }

// ============================================
// HMAC-SHA256 Implementation
// ============================================

function hmacSha256(key, message) {
    // Convert key to byte array
    var keyBytes = [];
    for (var i = 0; i < key.length; i++) {
        keyBytes.push(key.charCodeAt(i) & 0xFF);
    }

    // If key is longer than 64 bytes, hash it
    if (keyBytes.length > 64) {
        var keyHash = sha256(key);
        keyBytes = [];
        for (var i = 0; i < keyHash.length; i += 2) {
            keyBytes.push(parseInt(keyHash.substr(i, 2), 16));
        }
    }

    // Pad key to 64 bytes
    var ipad = [];
    var opad = [];
    
    for (var i = 0; i < 64; i++) {
        var b = i < keyBytes.length ? keyBytes[i] : 0;
        ipad.push(b ^ 0x36);
        opad.push(b ^ 0x5C);
    }

    // Build inner message: ipad || message
    var innerMsg = "";
    for (var i = 0; i < 64; i++) {
        innerMsg += String.fromCharCode(ipad[i]);
    }
    innerMsg += message;

    // Inner hash
    var innerHash = sha256(innerMsg);

    // Build outer message: opad || innerHash
    var outerMsg = "";
    for (var i = 0; i < 64; i++) {
        outerMsg += String.fromCharCode(opad[i]);
    }
    // Convert innerHash hex to string
    for (var i = 0; i < innerHash.length; i += 2) {
        outerMsg += String.fromCharCode(parseInt(innerHash.substr(i, 2), 16));
    }

    // Return outer hash as byte array
    var resultHex = sha256(outerMsg);
    var resultBytes = [];
    for (var i = 0; i < resultHex.length; i += 2) {
        resultBytes.push(parseInt(resultHex.substr(i, 2), 16));
    }
    return resultBytes;
}

// ============================================
// Base64URL Encoding (RFC 4648)
// ============================================

var BASE64URL_CHARS = "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789-_";

function base64UrlEncode(bytes) {
    var result = "";
    var i = 0;
    
    while (i < bytes.length) {
        var b1 = bytes[i++];
        var b2 = i < bytes.length ? bytes[i++] : -1;
        var b3 = i < bytes.length ? bytes[i++] : -1;

        // 6-bit groups
        var bitmap = (b1 << 16) | ((b2 & 0xFF) << 8) | (b3 & 0xFF);
        
        result += BASE64URL_CHARS.charAt((bitmap >> 18) & 63);
        result += BASE64URL_CHARS.charAt((bitmap >> 12) & 63);
        result += b2 !== -1 ? BASE64URL_CHARS.charAt((bitmap >> 6) & 63) : "";
        result += b3 !== -1 ? BASE64URL_CHARS.charAt(bitmap & 63) : "";
    }

    return result;

function base64EncodeString(str) {

function hmacSha256(key, message) {

    for (var i = 0; i < 64; i++) {

    innerMsg += message;

    var innerHash = sha256(innerMsg);

    // Build outer message: opad || innerHash
    var outerMsg = "";
    for (var i = 0; i < 64; i++) {
        outerMsg += String.fromCharCode(opad[i]);
    }

var BASE64URL_CHARS = "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789-_";

function base64UrlEncode(bytes) {

/**

 * JWT Generator for JScript - Therefore scripting engine
 * Includes HMAC-SHA256 and Base64 implementations
 * No external dependencies required
 * Use this script to create a JWT in a Therefore workflow,
 * this enables you to execute a REST call as a particular user, such as create document etc
 * rather than having it performed by a predefined user. Define one Custom JWT configuration in 
 * Therefore, and re-use it for any user you want to impersonate when doing a REST Call

// ============================================
// SHA256 Implementation
// ============================================

function sha256(message) {
    // SHA256 constants - first 32 bits of fractional parts of cube roots of first 64 primes
    var K = [
        0x428a2f98, 0x71374491, 0xb5c0fbcf, 0xe9b5dba5, 0x3956c25b, 0x59f111f1, 0x923f82a4, 0xab1c5ed5,
        0xd807aa98, 0x12835b01, 0x243185be, 0x550c7dc3, 0x72be5d74, 0x80deb1fe, 0x9bdc06a7, 0xc19bf174,
        0xe49b69c1, 0xefbe4786, 0x0fc19dc6, 0x240ca1cc, 0x2de92c6f, 0x4a7484aa, 0x5cb0a9dc, 0x76f988da,
        0x983e5152, 0xa831c66d, 0xb00327c8, 0xbf597fc7, 0xc6e00bf3, 0xd5a79147, 0x06ca6351, 0x14292967,
        0x27b70a85, 0x2e1b2138, 0x4d2c6dfc, 0x53380d13, 0x650a7354, 0x766a0abb, 0x81c2c92e, 0x92722c85,
        0xa2bfe8a1, 0xa81a664b, 0xc24b8b70, 0xc76c51a3, 0xd192e819, 0xd6990624, 0xf40e3585, 0x106aa070,
        0x19a4c116, 0x1e376c08, 0x2748774c, 0x34b0bcb5, 0x391c0cb3, 0x4ed8aa4a, 0x5b9cca4f, 0x682e6ff3,
        0x748f82ee, 0x78a5636f, 0x84c87814, 0x8cc70208, 0x90befffa, 0xa4506ceb, 0xbef9a3f7, 0xc67178f2
    ];

    // Initial hash values - first 32 bits of fractional parts of square roots of first 8 primes
    var H = [0x6a09e667, 0xbb67ae85, 0x3c6ef372, 0xa54ff53a, 0x510e527f, 0x9b05688c, 0x1f83d9ab, 0x5be0cd19];

    // Convert message string to byte array (ASCII only for JScript compatibility)
    var msgBytes = [];
    for (var i = 0; i < message.length; i++) {
        msgBytes.push(message.charCodeAt(i) & 0xFF);
    }

    // Padding
    var bitLen = msgBytes.length * 8;
    msgBytes.push(0x80);
    while ((msgBytes.length % 64) !== 56) {
        msgBytes.push(0);
    }
    
    // Append length as 64-bit big-endian
    msgBytes.push(0);
    msgBytes.push(0);
    msgBytes.push(0);
    msgBytes.push(0);
    msgBytes.push((bitLen >>> 24) & 0xFF);
    msgBytes.push((bitLen >>> 16) & 0xFF);
    msgBytes.push((bitLen >>> 8) & 0xFF);
    msgBytes.push(bitLen & 0xFF);

    // Process each 64-byte chunk
    for (var chunkStart = 0; chunkStart < msgBytes.length; chunkStart += 64) {
        var W = new Array(64);
        
        // Break chunk into sixteen 32-bit words
        for (var i = 0; i < 16; i++) {
            W[i] = ((msgBytes[chunkStart + i * 4] << 24) |
                    (msgBytes[chunkStart + i * 4 + 1] << 16) |
                    (msgBytes[chunkStart + i * 4 + 2] << 8) |
                    (msgBytes[chunkStart + i * 4 + 3])) >>> 0;
        }

        // Extend the sixteen 32-bit words into sixty-four 32-bit words
        for (var i = 16; i < 64; i++) {
            var s0 = ((W[i - 15] >>> 7) | (W[i - 15] << 25)) ^
                     ((W[i - 15] >>> 18) | (W[i - 15] << 14)) ^
                     (W[i - 15] >>> 3);
            var s1 = ((W[i - 2] >>> 17) | (W[i - 2] << 15)) ^
                     ((W[i - 2] >>> 19) | (W[i - 2] << 13)) ^
                     (W[i - 2] >>> 10);
            W[i] = (W[i - 16] + s0 + W[i - 7] + s1) >>> 0;
        }

        // Initialize working variables
        var a = H[0], b = H[1], c = H[2], d = H[3];
        var e = H[4], f = H[5], g = H[6], h = H[7];

        // Compression loop
        for (var i = 0; i < 64; i++) {
            var S1 = ((e >>> 6) | (e << 26)) ^
                     ((e >>> 11) | (e << 21)) ^
                     ((e >>> 25) | (e << 7));
            var ch = (e & f) ^ ((~e) & g);
            var temp1 = (h + S1 + ch + K[i] + W[i]) >>> 0;
            var S0 = ((a >>> 2) | (a << 30)) ^
                     ((a >>> 13) | (a << 19)) ^
                     ((a >>> 22) | (a << 10));
            var maj = (a & b) ^ (a & c) ^ (b & c);
            var temp2 = (S0 + maj) >>> 0;

            h = g;
            g = f;
            f = e;
            e = (d + temp1) >>> 0;
            d = c;
            c = b;
            b = a;
            a = (temp1 + temp2) >>> 0;
        }

        // Add to hash
        H[0] = (H[0] + a) >>> 0;
        H[1] = (H[1] + b) >>> 0;
        H[2] = (H[2] + c) >>> 0;
        H[3] = (H[3] + d) >>> 0;
        H[4] = (H[4] + e) >>> 0;
        H[5] = (H[5] + f) >>> 0;
        H[6] = (H[6] + g) >>> 0;
        H[7] = (H[7] + h) >>> 0;
    }

    // Convert hash to hex string
    var hex = "0123456789abcdef";
    var result = "";
    for (var i = 0; i < 8; i++) {
        for (var j = 7; j >= 0; j--) {
            result += hex.charAt((H[i] >>> (j * 4)) & 0xF);
        }
    }
    return result;
}

// ============================================
// HMAC-SHA256 Implementation
// ============================================

function hmacSha256(key, message) {
    // Convert key to byte array
    var keyBytes = [];
    for (var i = 0; i < key.length; i++) {
        keyBytes.push(key.charCodeAt(i) & 0xFF);
    }

    // If key is longer than 64 bytes, hash it
    if (keyBytes.length > 64) {
        var keyHash = sha256(key);
        keyBytes = [];
        for (var i = 0; i < keyHash.length; i += 2) {
            keyBytes.push(parseInt(keyHash.substr(i, 2), 16));
        }
    }

    // Pad key to 64 bytes
    var ipad = [];
    var opad = [];
    
    for (var i = 0; i < 64; i++) {
        var b = i < keyBytes.length ? keyBytes[i] : 0;
        ipad.push(b ^ 0x36);
        opad.push(b ^ 0x5C);
    }

    // Build inner message: ipad || message
    var innerMsg = "";
    for (var i = 0; i < 64; i++) {
        innerMsg += String.fromCharCode(ipad[i]);
    }
    innerMsg += message;

    // Inner hash
    var innerHash = sha256(innerMsg);

    // Build outer message: opad || innerHash
    var outerMsg = "";
    for (var i = 0; i < 64; i++) {
        outerMsg += String.fromCharCode(opad[i]);
    }
    // Convert innerHash hex to string
    for (var i = 0; i < innerHash.length; i += 2) {
        outerMsg += String.fromCharCode(parseInt(innerHash.substr(i, 2), 16));
    }

    // Return outer hash as byte array
    var resultHex = sha256(outerMsg);
    var resultBytes = [];
    for (var i = 0; i < resultHex.length; i += 2) {
        resultBytes.push(parseInt(resultHex.substr(i, 2), 16));
    }
    return resultBytes;
}

// ============================================
// Base64URL Encoding (RFC 4648)
// ============================================

var BASE64URL_CHARS = "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789-_";

function base64UrlEncode(bytes) {
    var result = "";
    var i = 0;
    
    while (i < bytes.length) {
        var b1 = bytes[i++];
        var b2 = i < bytes.length ? bytes[i++] : -1;
        var b3 = i < bytes.length ? bytes[i++] : -1;

        // 6-bit groups
        var bitmap = (b1 << 16) | ((b2 & 0xFF) << 8) | (b3 & 0xFF);
        
        result += BASE64URL_CHARS.charAt((bitmap >> 18) & 63);
        result += BASE64URL_CHARS.charAt((bitmap >> 12) & 63);
        result += b2 !== -1 ? BASE64URL_CHARS.charAt((bitmap >> 6) & 63) : "";
        result += b3 !== -1 ? BASE64URL_CHARS.charAt(bitmap & 63) : "";
    }

    return result;
}

function base64EncodeString(str) {
    var chars = "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789+/=";
    var out = "";
    var i = 0;
    while (i < str.length) {
        var c1 = str.charCodeAt(i++) & 0xff;
        var c2 = str.charCodeAt(i++) & 0xff;
        var c3 = str.charCodeAt(i++) & 0xff;
        
        out += chars.charAt(c1 >> 2);
        out += chars.charAt(((c1 & 0x3) << 4) | (c2 >> 4));
        out += isNaN(c2) ? "=" : chars.charAt(((c2 & 0xf) << 2) | (c3 >> 6));
        out += isNaN(c3) ? "=" : chars.charAt(c3 & 0x3f);
    }
    return out;
}

function stringToBytes(str) {
    var bytes = [];
    for (var i = 0; i < str.length; i++) {
        var c = str.charCodeAt(i);
        // UTF-8 encoding
        if (c < 128) {
            bytes.push(c);
        } else if (c < 2048) {
            bytes.push(0xC0 | (c >> 6));
            bytes.push(0x80 | (c & 0x3F));
        } else {
            bytes.push(0xE0 | (c >> 12));
            bytes.push(0x80 | ((c >> 6) & 0x3F));
            bytes.push(0x80 | (c & 0x3F));
        }
    }
    return bytes;
}

// ============================================
// JWT Generator
// ============================================

function generateJWT(header, payload, secret) {
    // Convert objects to JSON strings
    var headerJSON = JSON.stringify(header);
    var payloadJSON = JSON.stringify(payload);

    // Encode header and payload to Base64URL
    var headerBase64 = base64UrlEncode(stringToBytes(headerJSON));
    var payloadBase64 = base64UrlEncode(stringToBytes(payloadJSON));

    // Create signing input
    var signingInput = headerBase64 + "." + payloadBase64;

    // Sign with HMAC-SHA256
    var signatureBytes = hmacSha256(secret, signingInput);
    var signatureBase64 = base64UrlEncode(signatureBytes);

    // Return complete JWT
    return signingInput + "." + signatureBase64;
}

// ============================================
// Main Execution
// ============================================

function createToken(issuer, tenantCustomerId, expiration_seconds, scope, username, secret) {
    // JWT Header
    var header = {
        "alg": "HS256",
        "typ": "JWT"
    };
    
    var now = Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000);
    // JWT Payload
    var payload = {
        "iss": issuer,
        "aud": tenantCustomerId,
        "nbf": now,
        "exp": now + expiration_seconds,
        "urn:oauth:scope": scope,
        "http://schemas.microsoft.com/ws/2008/06/identity/claims/windowsaccountname": username
    };

    // Generate JWT
    return generateJWT(header, payload, secret);
}

<callrestsequence><calls><Elem><url>theservice/v0001/restun/SaveDocumentIndexDataQuick</url><verb>POST</verb><urlpar></urlpar><hdrpar><Elem><K>TenantName</K><V>"sumitomo"</V><D></D></Elem></hdrpar><initscript>https://sumitomo.thereforeonline.com/theservice/v0001/restun/help/operations/SaveEFormDraft

/**
 * 
 * JWT Generator for JScript - Therefore scripting engine
 * Includes HMAC-SHA256 and Base64 implementations
 * No external dependencies required
 * Use this script to create a JWT in a Therefore workflow,
 * this enables you to execute a REST call as a particular user, such as create document etc
 * rather than having it performed by a predefined user. Define one Custom JWT configuration in 
 * Therefore, and re-use it for any user you want to impersonate when doing a REST Call
 */

// ============================================
// SHA256 Implementation
// ============================================

function sha256(message) {
    // SHA256 constants - first 32 bits of fractional parts of cube roots of first 64 primes
    var K = [
        0x428a2f98, 0x71374491, 0xb5c0fbcf, 0xe9b5dba5, 0x3956c25b, 0x59f111f1, 0x923f82a4, 0xab1c5ed5,
        0xd807aa98, 0x12835b01, 0x243185be, 0x550c7dc3, 0x72be5d74, 0x80deb1fe, 0x9bdc06a7, 0xc19bf174,
        0xe49b69c1, 0xefbe4786, 0x0fc19dc6, 0x240ca1cc, 0x2de92c6f, 0x4a7484aa, 0x5cb0a9dc, 0x76f988da,
        0x983e5152, 0xa831c66d, 0xb00327c8, 0xbf597fc7, 0xc6e00bf3, 0xd5a79147, 0x06ca6351, 0x14292967,
        0x27b70a85, 0x2e1b2138, 0x4d2c6dfc, 0x53380d13, 0x650a7354, 0x766a0abb, 0x81c2c92e, 0x92722c85,
        0xa2bfe8a1, 0xa81a664b, 0xc24b8b70, 0xc76c51a3, 0xd192e819, 0xd6990624, 0xf40e3585, 0x106aa070,
        0x19a4c116, 0x1e376c08, 0x2748774c, 0x34b0bcb5, 0x391c0cb3, 0x4ed8aa4a, 0x5b9cca4f, 0x682e6ff3,
        0x748f82ee, 0x78a5636f, 0x84c87814, 0x8cc70208, 0x90befffa, 0xa4506ceb, 0xbef9a3f7, 0xc67178f2
    ];

    // Initial hash values - first 32 bits of fractional parts of square roots of first 8 primes
    var H = [0x6a09e667, 0xbb67ae85, 0x3c6ef372, 0xa54ff53a, 0x510e527f, 0x9b05688c, 0x1f83d9ab, 0x5be0cd19];

    // Convert message string to byte array (ASCII only for JScript compatibility)
    var msgBytes = [];
    for (var i = 0; i < message.length; i++) {
        msgBytes.push(message.charCodeAt(i) & 0xFF);
    }

    // Padding
    var bitLen = msgBytes.length * 8;
    msgBytes.push(0x80);
    while ((msgBytes.length % 64) !== 56) {
        msgBytes.push(0);
    }
    
    // Append length as 64-bit big-endian
    msgBytes.push(0);
    msgBytes.push(0);
    msgBytes.push(0);
    msgBytes.push(0);
    msgBytes.push((bitLen >>> 24) & 0xFF);
    msgBytes.push((bitLen >>> 16) & 0xFF);
    msgBytes.push((bitLen >>> 8) & 0xFF);
    msgBytes.push(bitLen & 0xFF);

    // Process each 64-byte chunk
    for (var chunkStart = 0; chunkStart < msgBytes.length; chunkStart += 64) {
        var W = new Array(64);
        
        // Break chunk into sixteen 32-bit words
        for (var i = 0; i < 16; i++) {
            W[i] = ((msgBytes[chunkStart + i * 4] << 24) |
                    (msgBytes[chunkStart + i * 4 + 1] << 16) |
                    (msgBytes[chunkStart + i * 4 + 2] << 8) |
                    (msgBytes[chunkStart + i * 4 + 3])) >>> 0;
        }

        // Extend the sixteen 32-bit words into sixty-four 32-bit words
        for (var i = 16; i < 64; i++) {
            var s0 = ((W[i - 15] >>> 7) | (W[i - 15] << 25)) ^
                     ((W[i - 15] >>> 18) | (W[i - 15] << 14)) ^
                     (W[i - 15] >>> 3);
            var s1 = ((W[i - 2] >>> 17) | (W[i - 2] << 15)) ^
                     ((W[i - 2] >>> 19) | (W[i - 2] << 13)) ^
                     (W[i - 2] >>> 10);
            W[i] = (W[i - 16] + s0 + W[i - 7] + s1) >>> 0;
        }

        // Initialize working variables
        var a = H[0], b = H[1], c = H[2], d = H[3];
        var e = H[4], f = H[5], g = H[6], h = H[7];

        // Compression loop
        for (var i = 0; i < 64; i++) {
            var S1 = ((e >>> 6) | (e << 26)) ^
                     ((e >>> 11) | (e << 21)) ^
                     ((e >>> 25) | (e << 7));
            var ch = (e & f) ^ ((~e) & g);
            var temp1 = (h + S1 + ch + K[i] + W[i]) >>> 0;
            var S0 = ((a >>> 2) | (a << 30)) ^
                     ((a >>> 13) | (a << 19)) ^
                     ((a >>> 22) | (a << 10));
            var maj = (a & b) ^ (a & c) ^ (b & c);
            var temp2 = (S0 + maj) >>> 0;

            h = g;
            g = f;
            f = e;
            e = (d + temp1) >>> 0;
            d = c;
            c = b;
            b = a;
            a = (temp1 + temp2) >>> 0;
        }

        // Add to hash
        H[0] = (H[0] + a) >>> 0;
        H[1] = (H[1] + b) >>> 0;
        H[2] = (H[2] + c) >>> 0;
        H[3] = (H[3] + d) >>> 0;
        H[4] = (H[4] + e) >>> 0;
        H[5] = (H[5] + f) >>> 0;
        H[6] = (H[6] + g) >>> 0;
        H[7] = (H[7] + h) >>> 0;
    }

    // Convert hash to hex string
    var hex = "0123456789abcdef";
    var result = "";
    for (var i = 0; i < 8; i++) {
        for (var j = 7; j >= 0; j--) {
            result += hex.charAt((H[i] >>> (j * 4)) & 0xF);
        }
    }
    return result;
}

// ============================================
// HMAC-SHA256 Implementation
// ============================================

function hmacSha256(key, message) {
    // Convert key to byte array
    var keyBytes = [];
    for (var i = 0; i < key.length; i++) {
        keyBytes.push(key.charCodeAt(i) & 0xFF);
    }

    // If key is longer than 64 bytes, hash it
    if (keyBytes.length > 64) {
        var keyHash = sha256(key);
        keyBytes = [];
        for (var i = 0; i < keyHash.length; i += 2) {
            keyBytes.push(parseInt(keyHash.substr(i, 2), 16));
        }
    }

    // Pad key to 64 bytes
    var ipad = [];
    var opad = [];
    
    for (var i = 0; i < 64; i++) {
        var b = i < keyBytes.length ? keyBytes[i] : 0;
        ipad.push(b ^ 0x36);
        opad.push(b ^ 0x5C);
    }

    // Build inner message: ipad || message
    var innerMsg = "";
    for (var i = 0; i < 64; i++) {
        innerMsg += String.fromCharCode(ipad[i]);
    }
    innerMsg += message;

    // Inner hash
    var innerHash = sha256(innerMsg);

    // Build outer message: opad || innerHash
    var outerMsg = "";
    for (var i = 0; i < 64; i++) {
        outerMsg += String.fromCharCode(opad[i]);
    }
    // Convert innerHash hex to string
    for (var i = 0; i < innerHash.length; i += 2) {
        outerMsg += String.fromCharCode(parseInt(innerHash.substr(i, 2), 16));
    }

    // Return outer hash as byte array
    var resultHex = sha256(outerMsg);
    var resultBytes = [];
    for (var i = 0; i < resultHex.length; i += 2) {
        resultBytes.push(parseInt(resultHex.substr(i, 2), 16));
    }
    return resultBytes;
}

// ============================================
// Base64URL Encoding (RFC 4648)
// ============================================

var BASE64URL_CHARS = "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789-_";

function base64UrlEncode(bytes) {
    var result = "";
    var i = 0;
    
    while (i < bytes.length) {
        var b1 = bytes[i++];
        var b2 = i < bytes.length ? bytes[i++] : -1;
        var b3 = i < bytes.length ? bytes[i++] : -1;

        // 6-bit groups
        var bitmap = (b1 << 16) | ((b2 & 0xFF) << 8) | (b3 & 0xFF);
        
        result += BASE64URL_CHARS.charAt((bitmap >> 18) & 63);
        result += BASE64URL_CHARS.charAt((bitmap >> 12) & 63);
        result += b2 !== -1 ? BASE64URL_CHARS.charAt((bitmap >> 6) & 63) : "";
        result += b3 !== -1 ? BASE64URL_CHARS.charAt(bitmap & 63) : "";
    }

    return result;
}

function base64EncodeString(str) {
    var chars = "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789+/=";
    var out = "";
    var i = 0;
    while (i < str.length) {
        var c1 = str.charCodeAt(i++) & 0xff;
        var c2 = str.charCodeAt(i++) & 0xff;
        var c3 = str.charCodeAt(i++) & 0xff;
        
        out += chars.charAt(c1 >> 2);
        out += chars.charAt(((c1 & 0x3) << 4) | (c2 >> 4));
        out += isNaN(c2) ? "=" : chars.charAt(((c2 & 0xf) << 2) | (c3 >> 6));
        out += isNaN(c3) ? "=" : chars.charAt(c3 & 0x3f);
    }
    return out;
}

function stringToBytes(str) {
    var bytes = [];
    for (var i = 0; i < str.length; i++) {
        var c = str.charCodeAt(i);
        // UTF-8 encoding
        if (c < 128) {
            bytes.push(c);
        } else if (c < 2048) {
            bytes.push(0xC0 | (c >> 6));
            bytes.push(0x80 | (c & 0x3F));
        } else {
            bytes.push(0xE0 | (c >> 12));
            bytes.push(0x80 | ((c >> 6) & 0x3F));
            bytes.push(0x80 | (c & 0x3F));
        }
    }
    return bytes;
}

// ============================================
// JWT Generator
// ============================================

function generateJWT(header, payload, secret) {
    // Convert objects to JSON strings
    var headerJSON = JSON.stringify(header);
    var payloadJSON = JSON.stringify(payload);

    // Encode header and payload to Base64URL
    var headerBase64 = base64UrlEncode(stringToBytes(headerJSON));
    var payloadBase64 = base64UrlEncode(stringToBytes(payloadJSON));

    // Create signing input
    var signingInput = headerBase64 + "." + payloadBase64;

    // Sign with HMAC-SHA256
    var signatureBytes = hmacSha256(secret, signingInput);
    var signatureBase64 = base64UrlEncode(signatureBytes);

    // Return complete JWT
    return signingInput + "." + signatureBase64;
}

// ============================================
// Main Execution
// ============================================

function createToken(issuer, tenantCustomerId, expiration_seconds, scope, username, secret) {
    // JWT Header
    var header = {
        "alg": "HS256",
        "typ": "JWT"
    };
    
    var now = Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000);
    // JWT Payload
    var payload = {
        "iss": issuer,
        "aud": tenantCustomerId,
        "nbf": now,
        "exp": now + expiration_seconds,
        "urn:oauth:scope": scope,
        "http://schemas.microsoft.com/ws/2008/06/identity/claims/windowsaccountname": username
    };

    // Generate JWT
    return generateJWT(header, payload, secret);
}

/**
 * 
 * JWT Generator for JScript - Therefore scripting engine
 * Includes HMAC-SHA256 and Base64 implementations
 * No external dependencies required
 * Use this script to create a JWT in a Therefore workflow,
 * this enables you to execute a REST call as a particular user, such as create document etc
 * rather than having it performed by a predefined user. Define one Custom JWT configuration in 
 * Therefore, and re-use it for any user you want to impersonate when doing a REST Call
 */

// ============================================
// SHA256 Implementation
// ============================================

function sha256(message) {
    // SHA256 constants - first 32 bits of fractional parts of cube roots of first 64 primes
    var K = [
        0x428a2f98, 0x71374491, 0xb5c0fbcf, 0xe9b5dba5, 0x3956c25b, 0x59f111f1, 0x923f82a4, 0xab1c5ed5,
        0xd807aa98, 0x12835b01, 0x243185be, 0x550c7dc3, 0x72be5d74, 0x80deb1fe, 0x9bdc06a7, 0xc19bf174,
        0xe49b69c1, 0xefbe4786, 0x0fc19dc6, 0x240ca1cc, 0x2de92c6f, 0x4a7484aa, 0x5cb0a9dc, 0x76f988da,
        0x983e5152, 0xa831c66d, 0xb00327c8, 0xbf597fc7, 0xc6e00bf3, 0xd5a79147, 0x06ca6351, 0x14292967,
        0x27b70a85, 0x2e1b2138, 0x4d2c6dfc, 0x53380d13, 0x650a7354, 0x766a0abb, 0x81c2c92e, 0x92722c85,
        0xa2bfe8a1, 0xa81a664b, 0xc24b8b70, 0xc76c51a3, 0xd192e819, 0xd6990624, 0xf40e3585, 0x106aa070,
        0x19a4c116, 0x1e376c08, 0x2748774c, 0x34b0bcb5, 0x391c0cb3, 0x4ed8aa4a, 0x5b9cca4f, 0x682e6ff3,
        0x748f82ee, 0x78a5636f, 0x84c87814, 0x8cc70208, 0x90befffa, 0xa4506ceb, 0xbef9a3f7, 0xc67178f2
    ];

    // Initial hash values - first 32 bits of fractional parts of square roots of first 8 primes
    var H = [0x6a09e667, 0xbb67ae85, 0x3c6ef372, 0xa54ff53a, 0x510e527f, 0x9b05688c, 0x1f83d9ab, 0x5be0cd19];

    // Convert message string to byte array (ASCII only for JScript compatibility)
    var msgBytes = [];
    for (var i = 0; i < message.length; i++) {
        msgBytes.push(message.charCodeAt(i) & 0xFF);
    }

    // Padding
    var bitLen = msgBytes.length * 8;
    msgBytes.push(0x80);
    while ((msgBytes.length % 64) !== 56) {
        msgBytes.push(0);
    }
    
    // Append length as 64-bit big-endian
    msgBytes.push(0);
    msgBytes.push(0);
    msgBytes.push(0);
    msgBytes.push(0);
    msgBytes.push((bitLen >>> 24) & 0xFF);
    msgBytes.push((bitLen >>> 16) & 0xFF);
    msgBytes.push((bitLen >>> 8) & 0xFF);
    msgBytes.push(bitLen & 0xFF);

    // Process each 64-byte chunk
    for (var chunkStart = 0; chunkStart < msgBytes.length; chunkStart += 64) {
        var W = new Array(64);
        
        // Break chunk into sixteen 32-bit words
        for (var i = 0; i < 16; i++) {
            W[i] = ((msgBytes[chunkStart + i * 4] << 24) |
                    (msgBytes[chunkStart + i * 4 + 1] << 16) |
                    (msgBytes[chunkStart + i * 4 + 2] << 8) |
                    (msgBytes[chunkStart + i * 4 + 3])) >>> 0;
        }

        // Extend the sixteen 32-bit words into sixty-four 32-bit words
        for (var i = 16; i < 64; i++) {
            var s0 = ((W[i - 15] >>> 7) | (W[i - 15] << 25)) ^
                     ((W[i - 15] >>> 18) | (W[i - 15] << 14)) ^
                     (W[i - 15] >>> 3);
            var s1 = ((W[i - 2] >>> 17) | (W[i - 2] << 15)) ^
                     ((W[i - 2] >>> 19) | (W[i - 2] << 13)) ^
                     (W[i - 2] >>> 10);
            W[i] = (W[i - 16] + s0 + W[i - 7] + s1) >>> 0;
        }

        // Initialize working variables
        var a = H[0], b = H[1], c = H[2], d = H[3];
        var e = H[4], f = H[5], g = H[6], h = H[7];

        // Compression loop
        for (var i = 0; i < 64; i++) {
            var S1 = ((e >>> 6) | (e << 26)) ^
                     ((e >>> 11) | (e << 21)) ^
                     ((e >>> 25) | (e << 7));
            var ch = (e & f) ^ ((~e) & g);
            var temp1 = (h + S1 + ch + K[i] + W[i]) >>> 0;
            var S0 = ((a >>> 2) | (a << 30)) ^
                     ((a >>> 13) | (a << 19)) ^
                     ((a >>> 22) | (a << 10));
            var maj = (a & b) ^ (a & c) ^ (b & c);
            var temp2 = (S0 + maj) >>> 0;

            h = g;
            g = f;
            f = e;
            e = (d + temp1) >>> 0;
            d = c;
            c = b;
            b = a;
            a = (temp1 + temp2) >>> 0;
        }

        // Add to hash
        H[0] = (H[0] + a) >>> 0;
        H[1] = (H[1] + b) >>> 0;
        H[2] = (H[2] + c) >>> 0;
        H[3] = (H[3] + d) >>> 0;
        H[4] = (H[4] + e) >>> 0;
        H[5] = (H[5] + f) >>> 0;
        H[6] = (H[6] + g) >>> 0;
        H[7] = (H[7] + h) >>> 0;
    }

    // Convert hash to hex string
    var hex = "0123456789abcdef";
    var result = "";
    for (var i = 0; i < 8; i++) {
        for (var j = 7; j >= 0; j--) {
            result += hex.charAt((H[i] >>> (j * 4)) & 0xF);
        }
    }
    return result;
}

// ============================================
// HMAC-SHA256 Implementation
// ============================================

function hmacSha256(key, message) {
    // Convert key to byte array
    var keyBytes = [];
    for (var i = 0; i < key.length; i++) {
        keyBytes.push(key.charCodeAt(i) & 0xFF);
    }

    // If key is longer than 64 bytes, hash it
    if (keyBytes.length > 64) {
        var keyHash = sha256(key);
        keyBytes = [];
        for (var i = 0; i < keyHash.length; i += 2) {
            keyBytes.push(parseInt(keyHash.substr(i, 2), 16));
        }
    }

    // Pad key to 64 bytes
    var ipad = [];
    var opad = [];
    
    for (var i = 0; i < 64; i++) {
        var b = i < keyBytes.length ? keyBytes[i] : 0;
        ipad.push(b ^ 0x36);
        opad.push(b ^ 0x5C);
    }

    // Build inner message: ipad || message
    var innerMsg = "";
    for (var i = 0; i < 64; i++) {
        innerMsg += String.fromCharCode(ipad[i]);
    }
    innerMsg += message;

    // Inner hash
    var innerHash = sha256(innerMsg);

    // Build outer message: opad || innerHash
    var outerMsg = "";
    for (var i = 0; i < 64; i++) {
        outerMsg += String.fromCharCode(opad[i]);
    }
    // Convert innerHash hex to string
    for (var i = 0; i < innerHash.length; i += 2) {
        outerMsg += String.fromCharCode(parseInt(innerHash.substr(i, 2), 16));
    }

    // Return outer hash as byte array
    var resultHex = sha256(outerMsg);
    var resultBytes = [];
    for (var i = 0; i < resultHex.length; i += 2) {
        resultBytes.push(parseInt(resultHex.substr(i, 2), 16));
    }
    return resultBytes;
}

// ============================================
// Base64URL Encoding (RFC 4648)
// ============================================

var BASE64URL_CHARS = "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789-_";

function base64UrlEncode(bytes) {
    var result = "";
    var i = 0;
    
    while (i < bytes.length) {
        var b1 = bytes[i++];
        var b2 = i < bytes.length ? bytes[i++] : -1;
        var b3 = i < bytes.length ? bytes[i++] : -1;

        // 6-bit groups
        var bitmap = (b1 << 16) | ((b2 & 0xFF) << 8) | (b3 & 0xFF);
        
        result += BASE64URL_CHARS.charAt((bitmap >> 18) & 63);
        result += BASE64URL_CHARS.charAt((bitmap >> 12) & 63);
        result += b2 !== -1 ? BASE64URL_CHARS.charAt((bitmap >> 6) & 63) : "";
        result += b3 !== -1 ? BASE64URL_CHARS.charAt(bitmap & 63) : "";
    }

    return result;
}

function base64EncodeString(str) {
    var chars = "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789+/=";
    var out = "";
    var i = 0;
    while (i < str.length) {
        var c1 = str.charCodeAt(i++) & 0xff;
        var c2 = str.charCodeAt(i++) & 0xff;
        var c3 = str.charCodeAt(i++) & 0xff;
        
        out += chars.charAt(c1 >> 2);
        out += chars.charAt(((c1 & 0x3) << 4) | (c2 >> 4));
        out += isNaN(c2) ? "=" : chars.charAt(((c2 & 0xf) << 2) | (c3 >> 6));
        out += isNaN(c3) ? "=" : chars.charAt(c3 & 0x3f);
    }
    return out;
}

function stringToBytes(str) {
    var bytes = [];
    for (var i = 0; i < str.length; i++) {
        var c = str.charCodeAt(i);
        // UTF-8 encoding
        if (c < 128) {
            bytes.push(c);
        } else if (c < 2048) {
            bytes.push(0xC0 | (c >> 6));
            bytes.push(0x80 | (c & 0x3F));
        } else {
            bytes.push(0xE0 | (c >> 12));
            bytes.push(0x80 | ((c >> 6) & 0x3F));
            bytes.push(0x80 | (c & 0x3F));
        }
    }
    return bytes;
}

// ============================================
// JWT Generator
// ============================================

function generateJWT(header, payload, secret) {
    // Convert objects to JSON strings
    var headerJSON = JSON.stringify(header);
    var payloadJSON = JSON.stringify(payload);

    // Encode header and payload to Base64URL
    var headerBase64 = base64UrlEncode(stringToBytes(headerJSON));
    var payloadBase64 = base64UrlEncode(stringToBytes(payloadJSON));

    // Create signing input
    var signingInput = headerBase64 + "." + payloadBase64;

    // Sign with HMAC-SHA256
    var signatureBytes = hmacSha256(secret, signingInput);
    var signatureBase64 = base64UrlEncode(signatureBytes);

    // Return complete JWT
    return signingInput + "." + signatureBase64;
}

// ============================================
// Main Execution
// ============================================

function createToken(issuer, tenantCustomerId, expiration_seconds, scope, username, secret) {
    // JWT Header
    var header = {
        "alg": "HS256",
        "typ": "JWT"
    };
    
    var now = Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000);
    // JWT Payload
    var payload = {
        "iss": issuer,
        "aud": tenantCustomerId,
        "nbf": now,
        "exp": now + expiration_seconds,
        "urn:oauth:scope": scope,
        "http://schemas.microsoft.com/ws/2008/06/identity/claims/windowsaccountname": username
    };

    // Generate JWT
    return generateJWT(header, payload, secret);
}
